brief:
Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman denounced what he characterized as continued "brutal assaults" by occupation authorities against Palestinians, the Maan Wire reported. He stated that the kingdom's commitment to Palestinian rights represents a "firm position," according to the feed summary.

The crown prince vowed that Saudi Arabia will not halt its efforts until the Palestinian people obtain their rights and establish an independent state.

title: Saudi crown prince condemns Israeli attacks on Palestinians as brutal
